text: Teaching Objectives To help student obtain knowledge and ability of business management, economic management and enterprise management, and enable student to deal with all kinds of business management related work in all kinds of organizations. Main Courses Management, Technological Economics, Modeling and decision making technology, Fundamentals of Accounting, Macro-economics,Micro-economics, Management Information Systems,Financial Management, operations research, Statistics, Comprehensive Chinese, listening, Spoken Chinese Internship Human resources, planning, purchasing or sales management in the enterprise. Degree Awarded Bachelor Degree of Business Administration (BBA) . Future Career Graduates can engage in the field of human resources, planning, purchasing or sales management in the enterprise.
